_comment: Admissibility screen only: BASE notalk-strategy prompt, not deck-aware. Peak prompt tokens is a property of the deck (game length x board density); the deck-aware prompt adds a CONSTANT ~2.5k tokens to the system prefix, so a deck-aware peak is this measurement plus that constant. Screening with the base prompt avoids writing a 14k-char prompt for a deck that may not survive. Deck from mage-bench sample-decks 'Decks to Beat'; deckType Freeform because Freeform.java validates size only.
